svg.text: SECTION 1–1 (on axis D, through the central dome) · 1:100
· Beams: galvanised steel, dark-bronze powder coat, on the column lines at 3.0–5.75 m
· Façade bearing: steel ledger on anchors under the balcony slab (soffit +3.850)
· Street bearing: 9 columns 150×150 in the planter wall, wood-clad; cap +2.9
· C200 purlins at 1.2 m; 50 mm PU sandwich panel with a wood-look underside
· 5% fall to the street; box gutter along the street, downpipes inside the columns → planter
· Domes: over the chinars Ø6.0 and Ø4.4 with an open oculus Ø3.6 / Ø2.4 (the crown grows out,
rain falls into the tree pit); a closed Ø5.6 dome with a glazed lantern between them
· Dome: 12 bent ribs 100×50 on a level ring at +3.900, drum with jali windows (light + hot-air
exhaust), GRC girih brick-slip panels inside, terracotta skin on a membrane outside
· Timber slat ceiling only over the bar and the corridor (accent)
· Wave louvers under the balcony removed; the F2 façade stays open
· Typhoon: wind zone II, uplift anchorage; structural engineer to calculate
Concept · member sizes and connections per the structural engineer
